title: Rank of a low-degree junta frequency
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers, let $P$ be a set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin}(n)$, and let $S$ be a member of the family of subsets of the coordinates outside $P$ having size at most $ rac{3k}{4}$ rounded down. Its rank is its position in the canonical enumeration of that finite family, represented by an element of $	ext{Fin}$ whose size is the cardinality of the family.
hypotheses_covered: Finite set $P$ of coordinates in $	ext{Fin}(n)$
$S$ belongs to the defined low-degree junta Fourier family
